metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the first reading, Nick's mark, and the Shrew at two.

yesterday: Tomorrow you are in the old Hamlet at two. You are the ghost. The cry is the last of the light.
Augustine asked for the songs by Friday. You promised him a pointing.
The Princess wants a gown. John said it last night. He was not in the room this morning.
Set at Maw was the Rose. The sentence to Anne is still on the desk.
You ate little between the reading and the play.
